claims: Shrinking has been officially renewed for a fourth season on Apple TV+.
Shrinking had a planned three-season arc about grief.
Season 4 of Shrinking will feature a time jump.
Season 4 of Shrinking will feature a new story for the main cast including Jason Segel and Harrison Ford.
Season 4 of Shrinking is expected to launch in early 2027.
Co-creator Bill Lawrence described the next chapter as a completely new story.
Co-creator Bill Lawrence described the next chapter as moving away from the initial focus on grief to a new risky storyline.
Season 4 of Shrinking will jump forward a few years to see where the characters have landed.
The core ensemble is returning for Season 4 of Shrinking.
Harrison Ford is continuing in his role as Paul for Season 4 of Shrinking.
